answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, reduced by each unverified claim, rewards vest against future work. The violet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A signal of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ivory of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
